text: F=~/.config/vlc/vlcrc; sed -i 's/^#*qt-bgcone=.*/qt-bgcone=0/' $F; grep -q '^qt-bgcone=0' $F || echo qt-bgcone=0 >> $F; grep -n qt-bgcone $F
memo: Typed sed command in terminal to set qt-bgcone=0 in ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc (with fallback append + grep verify). If the \n did not execute it, press Enter next; then crop/read terminal to confirm 'qt-bgcone=0' line. Do NOT click Save in the still-open VLC prefs dialog (it would rewrite vlcrc).
